set -eu
H=$(/var/jb/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(open('/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe.new','rb').read()).hexdigest())")
echo "REMOTE_UPLOADED: $H"
[ "$H" = "b33d4e4acafe9106d51466491d3e6bb44828afb29a6e8f41d2bc306f4aeeae20" ] || { echo "HASH_MISMATCH"; exit 9; }
install -m 755 /tmp/macos_ws_event_probe.new /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe.final
/var/jb/usr/bin/ldid -S/var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/entitlements.plist /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe.final
mv /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe.final /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe
/var/jb/usr/bin/python3 /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macws_boot_trust.py --readd /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe
rm -f /tmp/macos_ws_event_probe.new
ls -l /var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe
/var/jb/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib;print('POSTSIGN:',hashlib.sha256(open('/var/mnt/rootfs/tmp/macos_ws_event_probe','rb').read()).hexdigest())"
echo "=== baseline ==="
/var/jb/usr/bin/chroot /var/mnt/rootfs /bin/echo HI
